agent.finish_summary: Fixed AttributeError regression: added `if token is None: return False` guard at the top of imt() in sqlparse/utils.py. This helper is called from many grouping.py match/valid callbacks with tokens (e.g. from token_next/token_prev) that can legitimately be None at token-list boundaries; the previous unguarded code crashed with 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'ttype'. Verified via manual sanity parses (SELECT, ORDER BY variants, assignment :=, AS aliasing, period grouping) all succeed post-fix.
